lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਉਧਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਦਯੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak laR laai udhaarian day sev amitaa ||19||
lines.translation: O Nanak, serve the Infinite Lord; grasp the hem of His robe, and He will save you. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੜੇ ਕੁਲਾਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dhaRe kulaah chit na aavai hekaRo ||
lines.translation: Worldly affairs are unprofitable, if the One Lord does not come to mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਤੰਨ ਫੁਟੰਨਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਂਈ ਵਿਸਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak seee ta(n)n phuta(n)n jinaa saa(n)ee visarai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the bodies of those who forget their Master shall burst apart. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paretahu keeton devataa tin karanaihaare ||
lines.translation: The ghost has been transformed into an angel by the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਸਿਖ ਉਬਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe sikh ubaarian prabh kaaj savaare ||
lines.translation: God has emancipated all the Sikhs and resolved their affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਪਕੜਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਅਨੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak pakaR pachhaaRian jhoothe darabaare ||
lines.translation: He has seized the slanderers and thrown them to the ground, and declared them false in His Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa prabh vadaa hai aap saaj savaare ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak's God is glorious and great; He Himself creates and adorns. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh bea(n)t kichh a(n)t naahi sabh tisai karanaa ||
lines.translation: God is unlimited; He has no limit; He is the One who does everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਜੀਆਂ ਕਾ ਪਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar saahibo jeeaa(n) kaa paranaa ||
lines.translation: The Inaccessible and Unapproachable Lord and Master is the Support of His beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hasat dei pratipaaladaa bharan pokhan karanaa ||
lines.translation: Giving His Hand, He nurtures and cherishes; He is the Filler and Fulfiller.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਚੇ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: miharavaan bakhasi(n)d aap jap sache taranaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself is Merciful and Forgiving. Chanting the True Name, one is saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa naanak daas saranaa ||20||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases You - that alone is good; slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਕਾ ਰਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ti(n)naa bhukh na kaa rahee jis daa prabh hai soi ||
lines.translation: One who belongs to God has no hunger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੋ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak charanee lagiaa udharai sabho koi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, everyone who falls at his feet is saved. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਬੂਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaachik ma(n)gai nit naam saahib kare kabool ||
lines.translation: If the beggar begs for the Lord's Name every day, his Lord and Master will grant his request.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਜਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paramesar jajamaan tisahi bhukh na mool ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord is the most generous host; He does not lack anything at all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੋੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man rataa govi(n)d sa(n)g sach bhojan joRe ||
lines.translation: To imbue the mind with the Lord of the Universe is the true food and dress.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਏ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: preet lagee har naam siu e hasatee ghoRe ||
lines.translation: To embrace love for the Name of the Lord is to possess horses and elephants.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਘਣੀ ਧਿਆਇ ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮੋੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj milakh khuseeaa ghanee dhiaai mukh na moRe ||
lines.translation: To meditate on the Lord steadfastly is to rule over kingdoms of property and enjoy all sorts of pleasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਦਰੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaadhee dar prabh ma(n)ganaa dar kade na chhoRe ||
lines.translation: The minstrel begs at God's Door - he shall never leave that Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਲੋੜੇ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ਕੀਚੇ
lines.transliteration: naanak man tan chaau ehu nit prabh kau loRe ||21||1|| sudh keeche
lines.translation: Nanak has this yearning in his mind and body - he longs continually for God. ||21||1|| Sudh Keechay||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee bhagataa(n) kee baanee ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree, The Word Of The Devotees:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree sree kabeer jeeu ke chaupade 14 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourteen Chau-Padhay Of Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਲਤ ਰਾਮ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab mohi jalat raam jal paaiaa ||
lines.translation: I was on fire, but now I have found the Water of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਤਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam udak tan jalat bujhaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: This Water of the Lord's Name has cooled my burning body. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਣ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: man maaran kaaran ban jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: To subdue their minds, some go off into the forests;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so jal bin bhagava(n)t na paaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: but that Water is not found without the Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪਾਵਕ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਹੈ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih paavak sur nar hai jaare ||
lines.translation: That fire has consumed angels and mortal beings,

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਜਨ ਜਲਤ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raam udak jan jalat ubaare ||2||
lines.translation: but the Water of the Lord's Name saves His humble servants from burning. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhav saagar sukh saagar maahee ||
lines.translation: In the terrifying world-ocean, there is an ocean of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: peev rahe jal nikhutat naahee ||3||
lines.translation: I continue to drink it in, but this Water is never exhausted. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer bhaj saari(n)gapaanee ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, meditate and vibrate upon the Lord, like the rainbird remembering the water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam udak meree tikhaa bujhaanee ||4||1||
lines.translation: The Water of the Lord's Name has quenched my thirst. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee kabeer jee ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਉ ਜਲ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maadhau jal kee piaas na jaai ||
lines.translation: O Lord, my thirst for the Water of Your Name will not go away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਠੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal mahi agan uthee adhikaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The fire of my thirst burns even more brightly in that Water. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਉ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਮੀਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) jalanidh hau jal kaa meen ||
lines.translation: You are the Ocean of Water, and I am just a fish in that Water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਜਲਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jal mahi rahau jalahi bin kheen ||1||
lines.translation: In that Water, I remain; without that Water, I would perish. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਹਉ ਸੂਅਟਾ ਤੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) pi(n)jar hau sooataa tor ||
lines.translation: You are the cage, and I am Your parrot.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਮੰਜਾਰੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jam ma(n)jaar kahaa karai mor ||2||
lines.translation: So what can the cat of death do to me? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਹਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਆਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) taravar hau pa(n)khee aahi ||
lines.translation: You are the tree, and I am the bird.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀ ਤੇਰੋ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)dabhaagee tero darasan naahi ||3||
lines.translation: I am so unfortunate - I cannot see the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan! ||3||
